name: Apartmenets Goldberger
beschreibung:
=== description ===

The Apartments Goldberger in Söll are available for holiday rentals. The accommodation is modern and comfortable, with each apartment featuring a fully equipped kitchen. The balcony offers stunning views of the mountain landscape. Söll is located in the Sölllandl region, a well-developed tourist area. In winter, the ski resorts of the Kitzbühel Alps are easily accessible. In summer, numerous hiking and cycling trails invite exploration. The accommodation is ideal for families and couples.
